note: Every LM_ material is a shared PBR library set (client/src/village/pbr/pbrLibrary.ts getPbrSet(id, tier, gl) -> createPbrMaterial(set, { repeatMeters: [1, 1] })): the model's UVs are metres, COLOR_0 multiplies the albedo (the tint of the neutral sets), roughness = the ORM's G times roughnessScale. The lot has no maps of its own (letters, clock and numerals are geometry). M_glass is the game's glass; lotnight__ nodes take the game's glow. Lots v2 B3: the 75ab7df gate on the library's KTX2 sets; M_martgate_goods is the gate's own word-free atlas.

M_martgate_goods.note: word-free goods atlas (flag, flower-bed foliage, soil, the park's picture map): gate_goods.py

M_lamp.note: bulb / lantern glass: pale, a faint warm emission by day; lotnight__ nodes carry the night glow

M_sign_emit.note: glowing faces (marquee letters, uplights): unlit, COLOR_0 is the colour
